anti_collapse.note: The one comparison reference is provenance_class owner_created (a golden fixture authored directly for this repository, not an agent-generated output), so the generated_output-monoculture rule does not apply. Recorded honestly: this is still a comparison against exactly one fixture, not a real corpus of independently produced GOOD references — evals/real-output-corpus/ has no populated entries yet, so this dogfood run compares the two real prose texts that were actually available in the repository rather than fabricating a broader reference set.

dimensions.evidence_span: Subject (G-04) opens with a falsifiable thesis: "오래된 책의 종이가 손끝에서 부서질 정도가 되면 탈산 처리는 이미 늦었을 수 있다." Reference (G-01) opens with an equally falsifiable thesis: "추론 가격이 내려가도 SaaS gross margin은 회복되지 않는다." Both name a position a reader could disagree with in the first sentence.
dimensions.rationale: Neither piece merely describes a topic; both stake a checkable claim before any supporting material is introduced.

dimensions.evidence_span: G-01 introduces an explanatory mechanism the two source facts do not state themselves: "여기서 seat 기반 과금이 완충 장치가 아니라 증폭 장치로 작동한다... 단가 30% 하락이 소비량 50% 증가와 만나면 COGS는 늘어난다." G-04's synthesis instead narrows the applicability of one program's results against a second study's findings — "이 결과는 대규모 탈산이 효과가 없다는 반론이라기보다 적용 범위를 좁힌다" — which reconciles two sources but does not construct a new causal mechanism connecting them the way G-01's seat-billing-as-amplifier argument does.
dimensions.rationale: Both pieces synthesize rather than list, but G-01's synthesis produces an argument neither source states on its own; G-04's synthesis mainly draws a boundary between two sources' claims.

dimensions.evidence_span: Both read as native, hedged Korean expository prose rather than translated or mechanically templated text — e.g. G-04's "종이 안의 산을 중화하는 것과 끊어진 셀룰로오스 사슬을 되돌리는 일은 같지 않기 때문이다" and G-01's "단가가 내려간 것은 list price이고, 마진을 결정하는 것은 seat당 실제 소비량이기 때문이다" both use natural clause-final reasoning constructions ("~때문이다") consistent with editorial/voice.md's register rather than an awkward calque.
dimensions.rationale: No stilted phrasing, unnatural word order, or machine-translation tell was found in either subject or reference.

dimensions.evidence_span: Both pieces close on a bolded reframing sentence — G-04: "**아직 남아 있는 시간을 덜 빠르게 쓰게 만드는 보존 조치**"; G-01 bolds mid-argument rather than at the close ("**list price**"), so the shapes are not actually identical. With only these two texts available in this dogfood run, there is not enough of a corpus to tell whether a bolded-closing-reframe is a genuine repeated house-style tic or a coincidence of two fixtures.
dimensions.rationale: A real judgement here needs more than n=2 texts; abstaining is honest rather than declaring a pattern from one pair.

dimensions.evidence_span: Neither evals/fixtures/golden/G-01-synthesis.md nor evals/fixtures/golden/G-04-research-native-korean.md carries a stated target audience (both are L0 golden fixtures demonstrating article shape, not artifacts tied to an Editorial Intent audience axis).
dimensions.rationale: audience-fit is judged against a named audience profile's traits; with no audience declared for either text, any verdict here would be an invented comparison, not an observation.

integrity.evidence_span: Subject (G-04) states a specific, precise figure with no citation or source attribution at all: "한 보존 프로그램은 2001년 이후 약 20년에 걸쳐 550만 권가량을 처리했고" — no footnote marker, named institution, or source note anywhere in the text supports the "약 20년" / "550만 권" figures. (For context: the reference, G-01, at least carries footnote markers [^1][^2][^3] next to its load-bearing claims, even though this dogfood run did not resolve where those footnotes point either.)
